decisions.rationale: Lead Gengar (Ghost immune to Fake Out, Shadow Tag, Shadow Ball SE vs Farigiraf/Chandelure) with Empoleon (bulky, Fire resist, Stealth Rock). Back Bastiodon for Wide Guard vs spread (Eruption/Heat Wave/Hyper Voice) + Sturdy, and Arcanine for Intimidate/Will-O-Wisp and Fire SE vs Mawile. Exclude Grimmsnarl (Prankster shut by Armor Tail) and Lucario (redundant, weak to Fire/Ground).
decisions.notebook: Series 1-0 up, need 1 more win. Opponent TR team: Farigiraf (Armor Tail blocks our priority/Prankster; Imprison blocks Protect; TR/Imprison/PsychicNoise), Camerupt-Mega (SolidRock->SheerForce, Quiet), Mawile-Mega (HugePower, Brave), Chandelure-Mega (Infiltrator, Quiet), Liepard (Prankster FakeOut/Encore/Taunt), Heliolisk (Scarf, DrySkin). Arcanine Intimidate+WoW vs Mawile. Avoid Grimmsnarl vs Farigiraf (Prankster blocked).

decisions.rationale: Farigiraf’s Ghost immunity, Armor Tail, and Mental Herb stabilize against Mega Gengar/Lucario disruption while Scarf Heliolisk immediately pressures Empoleon and outspeeds Gengar. Mega Mawile supplies the preferred late-game Mega option; Camerupt gives Trick Room cleanup pressure.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 opponent brought Mega Gengar, Empoleon, Lucario, and Bastiodon. Mega Gengar: Timid, Shadow Ball/Sludge Bomb/Nasty Plot/Protect, willing to chain Protect. Empoleon: Calm Leftovers Torrent, Surf/Flash Cannon/Stealth Rock/Protect. Lucario: Adamant Life Orb Inner Focus, Close Combat/Meteor Mash/Bullet Punch/Protect. Bastiodon: Calm Sturdy Sitrus, Wide Guard/Protect/Stealth Rock/Body Press; survived Heliolisk Thunderbolt comfortably and Body Press OHKOed Heliolisk. Farigiraf Psychic Noise deals 57.5-106.7% to Mega Gengar across legal bulk. Scarf Heliolisk is guaranteed faster than unrevealed non-Mega Gengar speed range, and its Scarf speed should remain valuable versus Mega Gengar. Favor Farigiraf + Heliolisk pressure into the known Gengar/Empoleon core; preserve Mega Mawile as primary Mega and Camerupt for Trick Room endgames. Avoid relying on Mega Camerupt as the main plan due Empoleon/Bastiodon answers.

decisions.rationale: Shadow Ball is immune to both foes, so Gengar Mega Evolves for Shadow Tag to trap the Volt Switch/TR team and pressures Farigiraf with Sludge Bomb. Empoleon Flash Cannon (neutral) joins focus fire on the Trick Room setter; Heliolisk's 2x Thunderbolt on Empoleon is unavoidable but Leftovers + bulk let it survive.
decisions.notebook: Series 1-0 up, need 1 more win. Opponent TR team: Farigiraf (Armor Tail blocks priority/Prankster; Imprison blocks Protect; TR/PsychicNoise), Camerupt-Mega (SheerForce, Quiet), Mawile-Mega (HugePower, Brave), Chandelure-Mega (Infiltrator, Quiet), Liepard (Prankster FakeOut/Encore/Taunt), Heliolisk (Scarf, DrySkin). Our Gengar immune to Normal/Fighting (FakeOut) and traps with Shadow Tag; Shadow Ball SE vs Farigiraf/Chandelure but immune to Farigiraf/Heliolisk front (both Ghost-immune). Empoleon resists Fire, sets Rocks. Bastiodon Wide Guard vs spread. Arcanine Intimidate+WoW vs Mawile. Avoid Grimmsnarl vs Farigiraf (Prankster blocked). Plan: Mega Gengar Shadow Tag to trap, focus TR setter.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Heliolisk)
decisions.rationale: Switch Heliolisk before a potential Mega Gengar Shadow Tag, preserving it for later and bringing in the preferred Mega Mawile. Farigiraf can establish Trick Room through Gengar’s attacks; Mawile and Camerupt then give strong low-Speed endgame options, while Surf is resisted by Mawile.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s demonstrated four in Game 1 were Mega Gengar, Empoleon, Lucario, Bastiodon. Mega Gengar is Timid with Shadow Ball/Sludge Bomb/Nasty Plot/Protect and has shown willingness to chain Protect. Empoleon is Calm Leftovers Torrent with Surf/Flash Cannon/Stealth Rock/Protect. Lucario is Adamant Life Orb Inner Focus with Close Combat/Meteor Mash/Bullet Punch/Protect. Bastiodon is Calm Sturdy Sitrus with Wide Guard/Protect/Stealth Rock/Body Press; it survived Heliolisk Thunderbolt comfortably and Body Press OHKOed Heliolisk. Mega Gengar Sludge Bomb deals 43.6-59.5% to the exact Farigiraf; Empoleon spread Surf deals 22.5-33.0%. Preserve Heliolisk’s Scarf speed when possible, but switch it before Mega Gengar can trap it if pursuing Trick Room. Mega Mawile is the primary Mega; Camerupt is a Trick Room endgame piece but should avoid Empoleon/Bastiodon lines.

decisions.rationale: Gengar Sludge Bomb (1x, 90 pow, 222 SpA) KOs 14% Farigiraf, which is trapped by Shadow Tag and cannot switch. Empoleon Flash Cannon chips Mawile, avoiding overkill. Split targeting pressures both foes; Gengar survives Mawile's Sucker Punch (~53-62 dmg vs 137 HP) and Farigiraf's Psychic Noise. If Farigiraf Protects, Empoleon still damages Mawile.
decisions.notebook: Series 1-0 up, need 1 more win. Opponent TR team: Farigiraf (Armor Tail blocks priority/Prankster; Imprison blocks shared moves; TR/PsychicNoise; immune to Ghost per chart - use Sludge Bomb), Mawile-Mega (HugePower, Brave), Camerupt-Mega (SheerForce, Quiet), Chandelure-Mega (Infiltrator, Quiet), Liepard (Prankster FakeOut/Encore/Taunt), Heliolisk (Scarf, DrySkin). Our Gengar immune to Normal/Fighting (FakeOut), traps with Shadow Tag; Shadow Ball SE vs Chandelure. Empoleon resists Fire, sets Rocks. Bastiodon Wide Guard vs spread. Arcanine Intimidate+WoW vs Mawile. Plan: Mega Gengar Shadow Tag to trap and KO TR setter; remove Farigiraf first.

decisions.rationale: Gengar fainted, must switch. Trick Room favors slow Pokémon: Bastiodon (Spd 50) acts first and brings Wide Guard to block the opponent's spread attacks (Heliolisk Hyper Voice, Camerupt/Chandelure Heat Wave). Sturdy survives a hit; Body Press punishes Mawile. Arcanine is fastest (worst in TR) and less needed. Empoleon passes per menu. Bastiodon maximizes TR synergy and spread defense.
decisions.notebook: Series 1-0, need 1 win. Opponent TR team (revealed): Farigiraf (ArmorTail blocks priority/Prankster; Imprison blocks shared moves e.g. our Protect; TrickRoom/PsychicNoise; Normal/Psychic, immune to Ghost - use Sludge Bomb/Flash Cannon), Mawile-Mega (HugePower, Brave, slow; PlayRough/SuckerPunch/KnockOff; KnockOff 1.5x vs item holders, KO'd our Gengar), Heliolisk (ChoiceScarf, DrySkin, Timid; HyperVoice spread/Thunderbolt/GrassKnot). Possible unrevealed: Camerupt-Mega (SheerForce, Quiet, HeatWave/EarthPower spread), Chandelure-Mega (Infiltrator, Quiet, HeatWave spread), Liepard (Prankster FakeOut/Encore/Taunt). Our: Gengar ShadowTag traps, ShadowBall SE vs Chandelure, frail to Mawile. Empoleon resists Fire, sets Rocks, FlashCannon neutral. Bastiodon WideGuard blocks all spread (key vs Heliolisk/Camerupt/Chandelure), Sturdy, BodyPress. Arcanine Intimidate+WoW vs Mawile physical. Plan: in TR favor slow Bastiodon; WideGuard vs spread; finish Farigiraf with FlashCannon; handle Mawile via Intimidate/WoW or BodyPress.

decisions.rationale: Mega Knock Off followed by Psychic Noise guarantees a KO on Mega Gengar if both connect; Mawile acts before Farigiraf under Trick Room. Farigiraf is already in immediate KO range, so converting it into decisive damage is preferable to a temporary Protect while Gengar can Protect or Empoleon can remove it next turn.
decisions.notebook: Opponent Game 1 brought Mega Gengar, Empoleon, Lucario, and Bastiodon. Gengar is Timid Shadow Ball/Sludge Bomb/Nasty Plot/Protect and may chain Protect. Empoleon is Calm Leftovers Torrent with Surf/Flash Cannon/Stealth Rock/Protect. Lucario is Adamant Life Orb Inner Focus with Close Combat/Meteor Mash/Bullet Punch/Protect. Bastiodon is Calm Sturdy Sitrus with Wide Guard/Protect/Stealth Rock/Body Press; it survived Heliolisk Thunderbolt comfortably and Body Press OHKOed Heliolisk. Preserve Scarf Heliolisk where possible; Mega Mawile is the primary Mega and Camerupt is a Trick Room endgame option but dislikes Empoleon/Bastiodon.

decisions.rationale: Flash Cannon guarantees Farigiraf KO (14%). Splitting targets hedges a Protect: if Farigiraf shields, Body Press still chips Mawile (neutral ~20-47%); if Mawile shields, Flash Cannon still KOs Farigiraf. Mawile's best hits (SuckerPunch 26%, KnockOff 24%) can't KO Empoleon. Removes TR setter and chips Mawile.
decisions.notebook: Series 1-0, need 1 win. Opponent TR team: Farigiraf (ArmorTail blocks priority/Prankster; Imprison blocks shared moves incl our Protect; TrickRoom/PsychicNoise; Normal/Psychic, immune to Ghost). Mawile-Mega (HugePower, Brave, slow; PlayRough/SuckerPunch/KnockOff; SuckerPunch +1 and KnockOff 1.5x vs items both fail to KO Empoleon; KnockOff KO'd Gengar). Heliolisk (ChoiceScarf, DrySkin, Timid; HyperVoice spread). Unrevealed 4th: Camerupt/Camerupt-Mega (SheerForce, Quiet, HeatWave/EarthPower spread), Chandelure/Chandelure-Mega (Infiltrator, Quiet, HeatWave spread), or Liepard (Prankster FakeOut/Encore/Taunt). Our: Gengar fainted. Empoleon resists Fire, FlashCannon neutral, Heal Block active. Bastiodon WideGuard blocks all spread, Sturdy, BodyPress neutral vs Mawile. Arcanine Intimidate+WoW vs Mawile physical. Plan: TR favors slow Bastiodon; WideGuard vs spread; finish Farigiraf with FlashCannon; handle Mawile via BodyPress/Intimidate/WoW.

decisions.rationale: Farigiraf is unlikely to survive long enough to reset Trick Room, so maximize immediate chip while Mawile removes Empoleon’s Leftovers. This sets up Camerupt’s Ground pressure during the remaining Trick Room turns; Bastiodon cannot Wide Guard Earth Power.
decisions.notebook: Opponent has again brought Mega Gengar, Empoleon, and Bastiodon in Game 2; the fourth is still unknown. Empoleon is Calm Leftovers Torrent with Surf, Flash Cannon, Stealth Rock, Protect. Bastiodon is Calm Sturdy Sitrus with Wide Guard, Protect, Stealth Rock, Body Press. Mega Mawile’s Knock Off is useful for stripping Empoleon’s Leftovers; Psychic Noise has applied Heal Block to Empoleon. Preserve Scarf Heliolisk where possible. Camerupt is a Trick Room endgame option: Ground attacks threaten both Empoleon and Bastiodon and are not stopped by Wide Guard.

decisions.rationale: Bring Camerupt into the remaining Trick Room turns; it threatens both Steel-types with Ground pressure while preserving Scarf Heliolisk for later speed control.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s Game 2 core includes Mega Gengar, Calm Leftovers Empoleon (Surf/Flash Cannon/Stealth Rock/Protect), and Calm Sturdy Sitrus Bastiodon (Wide Guard/Protect/Stealth Rock/Body Press); fourth remains unknown among Grimmsnarl, Arcanine, Lucario. Empoleon’s Leftovers was removed and Psychic Noise can deny recovery. Under Trick Room, Mega Camerupt is the preferred endgame breaker versus Empoleon/Bastiodon; its single-target Ground pressure bypasses Wide Guard. Preserve Choice Scarf Heliolisk when possible. Mega Mawile has shown Intimidate pre-Mega and Knock Off utility.

decisions.rationale: Empoleon at 9% dies to Mawile Sucker Punch before acting, so it Protects (also blocks Earth Power). Bastiodon Body Press KOs Mawile-Mega (38% HP, 2x Fighting, ~100 dmg > its remaining HP) unless it Protects; Sturdy+Sitrus keep Bastiodon alive vs Earth Power. Wide Guard unneeded: Empoleon immune, Bastiodon resists Fire.
decisions.notebook: Series 1-0, need 1 win. Opponent TR team: Farigiraf (ArmorTail blocks priority/Prankster; Imprison blocks shared moves; TrickRoom/PsychicNoise; Normal/Psychic immune Ghost) fainted G2. Mawile-Mega: HugePower/Brave slow; PlayRough/SuckerPunch(+1, fails vs Protect/non-damaging)/KnockOff/Protect; KnockOff 1.5x items. Camerupt: Quiet, SolidRock/SheerForce Mega; EarthPower(4x Bastiodon via Sturdy, 2x Empoleon)/HeatWave/Eruption spread; Fire weak vs Steel/Rock. Heliolisk: ChoiceScarf DrySkin Timid; HyperVoice spread/Thunderbolt. Our Bastiodon: Sturdy+Sitrus, WideGuard blocks spread, BodyPress 2x Fairy KOs Mawile from ~40%; Calm. Empoleon: Fire resist, Surf 4x Camerupt, FlashCannon 0.5x; fragile, switch when safe. Arcanine: Intimidate+WoW vs Mawile physical; Adamant. Plan: use TR for slow Bastiodon, WideGuard vs spread, remove Mawile via BodyPress/Intimidate/WoW.

decisions.rationale: Mega Camerupt is guaranteed to move before Empoleon under Trick Room, and Earth Power is a guaranteed KO from its shown 8%. Protect preserves Mega Mawile from another likely Body Press while denying Bastiodon value this turn.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s Game 2 core includes Mega Gengar, Calm Leftovers Empoleon (Surf/Flash Cannon/Stealth Rock/Protect), and Calm Sturdy Sitrus Bastiodon (Wide Guard/Protect/Stealth Rock/Body Press); fourth remains unknown among Grimmsnarl, Arcanine, Lucario. Empoleon’s Leftovers was removed. Mega Camerupt’s single-target Ground pressure bypasses Wide Guard and threatens both Empoleon and Bastiodon; account for Bastiodon’s Sturdy/Sitrus when planning its removal. Preserve Choice Scarf Heliolisk when possible. Mega Mawile has shown Intimidate pre-Mega and Knock Off utility. Bastiodon Body Press dealt substantial damage to Mega Mawile.

decisions.rationale: KO Mawile (38% HP) with Body Press (2x Fairy, Sturdy-safe even if Mawile Sucker Punch first). Switch fragile 9% Empoleon to healthy Arcanine for Intimidate + bulk. Leaves Bastiodon + Arcanine vs lone Camerupt after TR ends.
decisions.notebook: Series 1-0, need 1 win to clinch. Opp TR team: Farigiraf fainted G2. Mawile-Mega: HugePower/Brave slow; PlayRough/SuckerPunch(+1, fails vs Protect)/KnockOff/Protect(reduced). Camerupt: Quiet SolidRock/SheerForce Mega; EarthPower(4x Bastiodon via Sturdy, 2x Empoleon)/HeatWave/Eruption spread; Fire weak vs Steel/Rock. Heliolisk: ChoiceScarf DrySkin Timid; HyperVoice spread. Our Bastiodon: Sturdy+Sitrus, WideGuard blocks spread, BodyPress 2x Fairy KOs Mawile. Empoleon: Fire resist, Surf 4x Camerupt, fragile. Arcanine: Intimidate+WoW vs Mawile physical; Adamant. Plan: TR for slow Bastiodon, WideGuard vs spread, remove Mawile via BodyPress/Intimidate/WoW.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Earth Power is a guaranteed KO on Empoleon at its shown HP and bypasses Wide Guard. Mawile’s Sucker Punch is redundant if Empoleon attacks and fails into Protect; Knock Off instead advances Bastiodon removal and strips its Sitrus Berry if it survives.
decisions.notebook: Opponent Game 2 revealed core: Mega Gengar (Shadow Ball/Sludge Bomb/Nasty Plot/Protect), Calm Leftovers Empoleon (Surf/Flash Cannon/Stealth Rock/Protect), and Calm Sturdy Sitrus Bastiodon (Wide Guard/Protect/Stealth Rock/Body Press). Fourth is one of Grimmsnarl, Arcanine, or Lucario. Empoleon’s Leftovers is gone. Bastiodon’s Wide Guard does not stop single-target Ground attacks; preserve Heliolisk for late-game cleaning where possible. Mega Mawile previously revealed Intimidate before evolving and has Knock Off utility.

decisions.rationale: Surf 4x KOs Camerupt even at full HP (SolidRock can't save it); Body Press 2x KOs Mawile (11%). If Mawile SuckerPunch KOs Empoleon first, Bastiodon still KOs Mawile; if Mawile Protects, Empoleon survives and Mawile dies next turn. Bastiodon then beats Heliolisk 1v1.
decisions.notebook: Series 1-0, need 1 win to clinch. Opp TR team: Farigiraf fainted G2. Mawile-Mega: HugePower/Brave slow; PlayRough/SuckerPunch(+1, fails vs Protect)/KnockOff/Protect. Camerupt: Quiet SolidRock; EarthPower 4x Bastiodon/2x Empoleon; Surf 4x KOs even full HP. Heliolisk: ChoiceScarf DrySkin Timid; HyperVoice spread. Bastiodon: Sturdy+Sitrus gone; WideGuard blocks spread; BodyPress 2x Fairy KOs Mawile. Empoleon: Fire resist, Surf 4x Camerupt. Plan: remove Mawile via BodyPress, Surf Camerupt.

decisions.rationale: Sucker Punch is guaranteed to remove Empoleon before its Surf, while Earth Power is a guaranteed KO on Bastiodon from its shown damage range. This covers the immediate double KO; if Bastiodon Protects, Empoleon still falls and Camerupt is preserved to finish Bastiodon with Heliolisk available.
decisions.notebook: Opponent Game 2 revealed core: Mega Gengar (Shadow Ball/Sludge Bomb/Nasty Plot/Protect), Calm Leftovers Empoleon (Surf/Flash Cannon/Stealth Rock/Protect), and Calm Sturdy Sitrus Bastiodon (Wide Guard/Protect/Stealth Rock/Body Press). Fourth is one of Grimmsnarl, Arcanine, or Lucario. Empoleon’s Leftovers and Bastiodon’s Sitrus Berry are gone. Bastiodon’s Wide Guard does not stop single-target Ground attacks. Preserve Choice Scarf Heliolisk for late-game cleaning where possible. Mega Mawile revealed Intimidate before evolving and has Knock Off utility.

reflections.summary: Lost because we brought and Mega Evolved Gengar (fast, fragile) into opponent's Trick Room, letting Mawile's Knock Off KO it turn 2; then we never used Empoleon's Surf (4x vs Camerupt) and instead chipped Mawile with Body Press while Camerupt's Earth Power exploited Bastiodon/Arcanine Ground weakness, causing a turn-6 sweep. Team preview was flawed: leading a fast Mega under TR and including Arcanine (weak to Ground) ill-suited this opponent.
reflections.adjustment: Next game, do not lead or Mega Evolve Gengar versus this TR team; lead Bastiodon+Empoleon to exploit Trick Room, and use Empoleon's Surf on Camerupt immediately on entry instead of Flash Cannon/Protect.
reflections.notebook: Series 1-1, need 1 win. Opp TR team: Farigiraf leads TR (ArmorTail) then faints; Mawile-Mega (Brave HugePower) KnockOff super effective vs Ghost, Protect blocks BodyPress, SuckerPunch finisher; Camerupt (Quiet SolidRock) EarthPower 4x Bastiodon/2x others, weak to Surf 4x; Heliolisk ChoiceScarf DrySkin unused; Chandelure/Liepard not brought G2. Our Gengar-Mega mismatched vs TR (fast/fragile). BodyPress insufficient to KO Mawile. Plan: lead slow core (Bastiodon/Empoleon), Surf Camerupt on entry, avoid Gengar Mega or bench it.

reflections.summary: Won by establishing Trick Room, removing Mega Gengar immediately with Mega Mawile, then using Camerupt’s single-target Ground pressure to clear Arcanine and Bastiodon while Mawile finished Empoleon. The Farigiraf/Mawile/Camerupt plan fit the revealed Gengar-plus-Steel core; Heliolisk contributed nothing after its turn-one switch.
reflections.adjustment: Against this same preview, lead Farigiraf + Mawile directly instead of leading Heliolisk only to switch it out. Keep Mega Mawile as the preferred evolution for immediate Gengar removal and physical pressure under Trick Room.
reflections.notebook: Opponent Game 2 brought Mega Gengar, Empoleon, Bastiodon, and Intimidate Arcanine; Grimmsnarl and Lucario were not selected. Revealed sets: Mega Gengar had Shadow Ball, Sludge Bomb, Nasty Plot, Protect; Empoleon had Surf, Flash Cannon, Stealth Rock, Protect; Bastiodon had Wide Guard, Protect, Stealth Rock, Body Press; Arcanine had Flare Blitz, Extreme Speed, Will-O-Wisp, Protect. Plan versus this Gengar/Steel structure: prioritize Farigiraf Trick Room plus Mega Mawile pressure on Gengar, then use Camerupt’s single-target Ground attacks through Bastiodon’s Wide Guard.
